text_block_list.text:
One weekend, after running countless races 
alongside Buena Vista—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~! I-I'm so sorry, I 
forgot my ph-phone...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been waiting at all, so please 
don't worry! ...Would you like a towel for 
your sweat?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, thank you so much...! I'm so sorry, 
even though this is supposed to be your 
celebration, Buena-san.

Buena Vista won several races in her 
Senior Year. Which means—

The Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen, 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and Arima 
Kinen... These races are—

“—They're all races that Special Week ran 
in, too. Not that that's the only reason, 
but...”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To think the very person who wanted to 
celebrate would be late...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, I ended up leaving all the 
outing plans to you, Trainer. I'm so 
useless, I'm sorry...
choice_data_list:
I enjoy researching things, so don't worry 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's just how you are, right, 
Trainer-san? I can't wait to see what kind 
of scenery awaits us!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to go out with you, 
Spe-san, is the greatest reward for me! 
—Let's have as much fun as we can today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! A real circus, no way...! Trainer, 
you sure found a great spot!
choice_data_list:
I just happened to find out it was 
happening nearby.

I just happened to find out it was 
happening nearby.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Looks like so much excitement is waiting 
for us...! —Let's dive right in!

text_block_list.name: Ringmaster
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone! Welcome to our 
earth-shattering circus! Allow me to whisk 
you away to a wondrous, magical world—

text_block_list.name: Ringmaster
text_block_list.text:
—Presented by our circus, the Aerial 
Troupe! Please enjoy their fantastical 
performance, combined with special 3D 
visuals!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Incredible...! We're flying through 
space...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Look, Spe-san! Over there, they're making 
constellations with the swings! Amazing, 
so amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Buena & Spe
text_block_list.text: Wooww...!
choice_data_list:
(Both of their eyes are sparkling just as 
brightly—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... That was amazing... Both humans 
and Umamusume can really fly...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm...! Buena-san, someday we'll—fly 
too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes—... Wait, what!? No, umm...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...If we believe, it'll surely come true! 
Yes. Let's fly, Spe-san!"
choice_data_list: (...Well, it's always good to dream big.)

(...Well, it's better to have big dreams, 
right?)

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Party of three, <username>. I will show you to your 
seats.
choice_data_list: Yes, I'll be right there.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly... This cafe is 
famous for its fluffy pancakes, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I thought you both would like it
Yeah, I thought both of you would like it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've heard so much about it...! It looked 
way too stylish, so I couldn't bring 
myself to enter, but...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day! The challenge menu: 50 
pancakes... I shall conquer it, Trainer!
choice_data_list: ...Me too!?

text_block_list.text:
And so, the special weekend spent with 
Special Week proceeded in high spirits—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! What a wonderful, beautiful 
chapel...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right...! Wow... There are so many 
flowers...
choice_data_list: (...I'm glad both of them are happy.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
In a wonderful place like this, being 
watched over by the people who matter most 
to me... How happy that would make me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...If Trainer-san and Spe-san could be 
there in that scenery too... I would be 
so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san... ...Of course, I'd rush over 
no matter where I am!"
choice_data_list: Of course, me too.
Of course, me too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you very much.
choice_data_list:
Ah, looks like we can take a photo holding 
a bouquet.

Ah, looks like you can take photos holding 
a bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Since I'm here, maybe I'll 
borrow it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Buena-san really is such a good girl, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the two Grand Prix races I 
couldn't before— the Takarazuka Kinen and 
the Arima Kinen—and live up to everyone's 
expectations to the fullest—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's long since become so much more 
amazing than me. And yet... she still 
looks up to me so much.
choice_data_list: My admiration will never change.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. It might sound strange 
coming from me, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure many things will happen in 
Buena-san's future from here on. But as 
long as you're together with her, 
everything will be fine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Please continue to look after 
Buena-san... from here on out too, okay!"
choice_data_list: ...Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Wh-Why are you speaking so formally 
to me~?!
choice_data_list:
Because it was entrusted to me by someone 
I admire...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Did something happen? The atmosphere 
feels a bit tense...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no~, it's nothing at all! Right, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, um... I'm counting on you from now 
on too, Buena.

Yeah, um... looking forward to working 
with you, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what's with you all of a sudden? 
...I am curious about what you were 
talking about, though—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I look forward to working with you 
from here on out too, Trainer♪
